about:
Benchmark’s Huntsville operation sits in the heart of Alabama’s Rocket City, at 4807 Bradford Drive. The site traces its manufacturing lineage to 1963, when the facility began serving the region’s emerging aerospace and defense sectors. Today it operates as part of Benchmark Electronics, a global contract manufacturer, with John Russell serving as general manager.

The plant provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing and engineering services. Its advanced manufacturing floor handles mechanical and precision machining, microelectronics, mixed and hybrid assembly, PCB assembly and surface-mount technology, and full system build and integration. Engineering teams deliver electrical, mechanical, and microwave/millimeter-wave design, software development, test development, and design-for-excellence support. The site also runs automation solutions, environmental stress screening, and mmWave test capabilities, backed by lifecycle management services including depot repair, sustaining engineering, and supply chain management.

Customers span commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, medical technologies, industrial, next-gen communications, and semiconductor capital equipment. The Huntsville team has built UAV communications modules and flight computers for FAA-regulated programs, scaled high-volume lidar sensor production for Ouster, delivered AI-enabled mobile surveillance systems for U.S. Customs and Border Protection, and manufactured components for Intel’s Aurora exascale supercomputer and HPE’s AI infrastructure. Other projects include autonomous mobile robot redesigns, satellite communication terminal transfers, and cryogenic kiosks for stem cell therapy.

Benchmark emphasizes its Buy American and TAA-compliant solutions, a workforce with an average 15-year tenure, and close collaboration with the company’s Minnesota and Santa Ana design centers. The site maintains ITAR registration and AS9100 certification to meet defense and aerospace requirements.
